smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Rendair
shortDescription: Turns a sketch or floor plan into a 3D project and a render. Starter is $19 a month.
longDescription: Rendair turns a sketch, a floor plan, or a 3D model into a project you can render and revise in chat. Uploading a 2D floor plan builds the 3D project, with walls, rooms, and volumes. Starter is $19 a month for 500 credits, Pro is $49 a month for 1,500 credits, and Studio Pro is $199 a month for 7,500 credits.
pricingNotes: Starter is $19 per month for 500 credits. Pro is $49 per month for 1,500 credits and 2 members. Studio Pro is $199 per month for 7,500 credits and 5 members. Annual billing saves 2 months.
bestFor: A 2D floor plan that should become a 3D project and a render
A sketch you want to revise in chat
notIdealFor: Virtual staging of a vacant listing photo
A generic image with no plan or sketch
strength: Rendair uploads a 2D floor plan, builds the 3D project, and generates renders you can revise on a board.
weakness: Starter is $19 per month, and the public pricing page does not list a free credit grant.

useCaseFit.floor-plan-rendering: Turns an uploaded floor plan into a 3D project and a render.
